title: Build the SDK-free core of the Companion module

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0086 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale companion-adapter-runtime-module' with the human electing the SDK-free-core-first approach — the eighth slice of the REQ-INT-002 Companion adapter, building the vendor-neutral module core toward the runnable module. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0086.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors, SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 / US-010, the 2026-08-25 user directive, and the human's AskUserQuestion choice of the SDK-free core.

claims.statement: The runnable Bitfocus Companion module needs the @companion-module/base SDK and can only be fully verified against real controller hardware, neither of which is committed or available here; its feedbacks also need live observations from the still-deferred feedback transport. The human elected to build the SDK-free core first: the module logic that is verifiable now without the dependency, hardware, or live feedback. REQ-INT-002 keeps hardware-specific behavior out of the core, which this honors — the SDK enters only a later thin wrapper.
claims.evidence: SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 (hardware-specific behavior does not enter the core); the deferred companion-adapter-feedback-transport node; the human's approach choice.

claims.statement: The core provides COMPANION_CONFIG_FIELDS (the baseUrl, token, and showId textinput fields a Companion instance needs), parseModuleConfig (trims and requires all three, reporting every missing field at once rather than a partial config), and buildCompanionActionDefinitions(actions, run) which maps discovered actions to a record keyed by actionId of { name, options, callback }, where a button press runs the injected command for that action with the visible option coerced to a boolean. It imports no @companion-module/base and holds no runtime state; the operationId, expected revision, and adapter live behind the run seam a later InstanceBase wrapper supplies.

Asserting the three config fields, that parseModuleConfig trims and reports all missing fields, and that each action definition is keyed by actionId with the action's name and options and a callback that runs the command for its own action with a strictly-coerced visible option, proves the module core assembles a Companion module's config and actions correctly without the SDK.

A focused adversarial review verified the core against the real types and found no defects: parseModuleConfig evaluates every field independently and reports all missing ones in a stable order with sound non-string coercion, the action callbacks each close over their own action (a per-iteration binding, not the shared-last-value trap), visible === true coerces every non-true value to false, and the actionId keying is the required Companion setActionDefinitions shape whose uniqueness is the catalog's contract, not this function's to enforce.
claims.evidence: the CHG-0086 focused review of companion/src/module.ts against companion/src/types.ts and companion/src/command.ts.

claims.statement: This is the module core only, not the runnable module: the @companion-module/base InstanceBase wrapper (registering these fields and actions and supplying the run seam), live feedbacks, packaging, and hardware verification remain deferred (frontier node companion-adapter-runtime-module), as do the live delta subscription and the Take/trigger catalog extension. Additive to the @overlaykit/companion package; no server, protocol, or Studio source changed, and no new dependency added.
claims.evidence: companion/src/module.ts (no @companion-module/base import); companion/package.json dependencies unchanged; the .frontier companion nodes.

successCriteria.statement: The core declares the connection config fields and validates raw config, reporting all missing fields at once.
successCriteria.verification: companion/tests/module.contract.test.ts asserts the three fields and parseModuleConfig's trim and all-missing behavior.

successCriteria.statement: buildCompanionActionDefinitions maps each discovered action to a keyed definition whose callback runs the command for that action with a strictly-coerced visible option.
successCriteria.verification: Tests assert the keyed definitions and that a callback invokes the injected run with the correct action and { visible }.

successCriteria.statement: The core adds no dependency and no existing behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: companion/package.json dependencies are unchanged; npm run check and npm run build pass across all workspaces.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0086 records the SDK-free-core scope, the run seam, and the deferred SDK-wrapper/feedback/hardware residuals before implementation of the record.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.
